data.summary: The independent validation of the FR-001 Card transaction fraud detector confirms strong discriminative power, with Gini — test reported as {{m:run_f6245a:gini.test}} and Gini — out-of-time as {{m:run_f6245a:gini.oot}}. Additional performance indicators include KS — out-of-time {{m:run_f6245a:ks.oot}}, AUC — hold-out {{m:run_f6245a:auc.holdout}}, Brier score — hold-out {{m:run_f6245a:brier.holdout}}, and Predicted × observed — hold-out {{m:run_f6245a:calibration_ratio.holdout}}. The model’s observed outcome rate — hold-out is {{m:run_f6245a:bad_rate.holdout}}, with Recall at coded threshold {{m:run_f6245a:recall_at.holdout}}, Precision at coded threshold {{m:run_f6245a:precision_at.holdout}}, Average precision (PR‑AUC) {{m:run_f6245a:avg_precision.holdout}} and Alert rate {{m:run_f6245a:alert_rate.holdout}}. Findings include {{m:run_f6245a:findings.high}} high‑severity and {{m:run_f6245a:findings.medium}} medium‑severity issues for a total of {{m:run_f6245a:findings.total}}, and parity checks show {{m:run_f6245a:coef_max_abs_diff}}, {{m:run_f6245a:score_max_abs_diff}} and rows compared {{m:run_f6245a:rows_compared}}. The overall rating is Requires remediation before continued use.
